post.title: Google Cloud sales more than doubled to $30.7B in a year
post.ig:
Google's cloud sales more than doubled in a single year.
Google Cloud brought in $30.7B in Jul-Sep 2026, up 103% from $15.2B a year earlier.
Microsoft's Azure cloud grew 48% in the same quarter.
Alphabet's total profit still fell about 25%, to $26.2B, mostly on investment losses, the company's filing shows.
Sources: Alphabet Q3 2026 release (Oct 28, 2026), Microsoft FY27 Q1 results, CNBC, Constellation Research.
